title: Local AI vs Cloud AI: Where Does Your Prompt Go?
headline:
Where does
your prompt go?
meaning: Local inference runs on your own device.
example: A downloaded model can process a note locally.
comparison: Cloud processing uses a remote server. Local uses your hardware.
caution: Local apps can still have network-connected features.
question: Which task would you keep local?
lines: When you ask an A I a question, the answer does not always come from a distant server.
Local A I runs a downloaded model on your own phone or computer. Cloud A I processes requests remotely.
A local app might summarize a sample note without sending that note to a model server.
The tradeoff is hardware. Your memory and processor limit which models run comfortably.
Do not assume every feature stays offline. Check the app, downloads, and network settings.
